---
title: "Patient-level disease state analysis"
---

```{r setup}
source(here::here("R", "paths.R"))
source(here::here("R", "exclusions.R"))
source(here::here("R", "metadata.R"))
library(tidyverse)
library(vroom)
library(readxl)
library(patchwork)
library(ggbeeswarm)

FIGURES_DIR <- out_path("figures")
dir.create(FIGURES_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

BASE         <- out_path("sequence-classifier")
METADATA_XLS <- data_path("metadata/2024-SRARunTable-MetadataCleaning.xlsx")
TRAIN_W      <- data_path("classifier/classifier_data_igblast-train-weights.csv")
TEST_W       <- data_path("classifier/classifier_data_igblast-test-weights.csv")
```

```{r load-ensemble-with-metadata}
# Load ensemble predictions and join with the weights CSV on row index.
# This brings in BSource, consensus_count, and weight alongside per-sequence scores.
load_ensemble_patient <- function(dir, model_label, train_weights, test_weights) {
  join_by_row <- function(preds_csv, weights_df) {
    preds <- read_csv(preds_csv, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(.row_idx = row_number())
    wt <- weights_df %>% mutate(.row_idx = row_number()) %>% select(-Disease)

    joined <- inner_join(preds, wt, by = ".row_idx", suffix = c("", "_wt"))
    stopifnot(all(joined$Author == joined$Author_wt))
    joined %>% select(-.row_idx, -ends_with("_wt"))
  }

  unflipped <- join_by_row(
    file.path(dir, "unflipped/predictions/ensemble_predictions.csv"),
    test_weights
  )
  flipped <- join_by_row(
    file.path(dir, "flipped/predictions/ensemble_predictions.csv"),
    train_weights
  )

  bind_rows(unflipped, flipped) %>%
    rename(
      prob_ms   = ms_score,
      Predicted = predicted_class,
      Disease   = true_label
    ) %>%
    mutate(model = model_label)
}

train_w <- vroom(TRAIN_W, show_col_types = FALSE)
test_w  <- vroom(TEST_W,  show_col_types = FALSE)

ENSEMBLE_DIRS <- list(
  "LM Exclusion AUGC" = file.path(BASE, "ensemble-output-exclusion"),
  "LM Baseline AUGC"  = file.path(BASE, "ensemble-output-baseline")
)

seq_preds <-
  imap(ENSEMBLE_DIRS, \(dir, lab) load_ensemble_patient(dir, lab, train_w, test_w)) %>%
  reduce(bind_rows) %>%
  # Remove small problematic datasets
  filter(Author != "PRJNA248475", Author != "PRJNA248411", Author != "PRJNA866296") %>%
  drop_duplicate_repertoires("Author", "Subject")   # R/exclusions.R
```

```{r load-sra-metadata}
# Re-join patient-level metadata dropped at dataset build time.
# Disease Class, EDSS, Patient State are patient-level — safe to join on Subject.
# Treatment is run-level and NOT recoverable here.
sra_meta <- read_metadata(METADATA_XLS) %>%
  select(BioProject, Age, Sex, DonorID,
         Disease_Class = `Disease Class`,
         Patient_State = `Patient State`,
         EDSS,
         Years_disease = `Years disease`) %>%
  mutate(Subject = paste(Age, Sex, DonorID)) %>%
  distinct(BioProject, Subject, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(-Age, -Sex, -DonorID)

seq_preds <- seq_preds %>%
  left_join(sra_meta, by = c("Author" = "BioProject", "Subject"))

# How many MS patients have Disease_Class?
seq_preds %>%
  filter(Disease == "Multiple sclerosis") %>%
  distinct(Author, Subject, Disease_Class) %>%
  count(Disease_Class, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r patient-aggregation}
# Weighted percentile via sorted cumulative weights (mirrors Python summarize_patients.py)
weighted_percentile <- function(scores, weights, p) {
  if (length(scores) == 1L) return(scores)
  idx           <- order(scores)
  sorted_scores <- scores[idx]
  cum_w         <- cumsum(as.numeric(weights[idx]))
  cum_w         <- cum_w / cum_w[length(cum_w)]
  approx(cum_w, sorted_scores, xout = p / 100, rule = 2)$y
}

# Aggregate to patient × tissue × model.
# ms_score_90pct = consensus-count-weighted 95th percentile of per-sequence MS scores (the 95th, as in
#   the Fig. 3A/3C legends; the name is historical).
# ms_score_median = consensus-count-weighted median of per-sequence MS scores.
patient_preds <- seq_preds %>%
  group_by(model, Author, Subject, BSource, Disease, Disease_Class,
           Patient_State, EDSS, Years_disease) %>%
  summarize(
    ms_score_90pct  = weighted_percentile(prob_ms, consensus_count, 95),
    ms_score_median = weighted_percentile(prob_ms, consensus_count, 50),
    n_seqs          = n(),
    .groups         = "drop"
  )

patient_preds %>%
  count(model, Disease, BSource)
```

```{r disease-class-plot}
CLASS_ORDER <- c("CIS","RRMS", "PPMS", "SPMS")

patient_preds %>%
  filter(
    Disease       == "Multiple sclerosis",
    BSource       == "Blood",
    Disease_Class %in% CLASS_ORDER,
    model         == "LM Exclusion AUGC"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Disease_Class = factor(Disease_Class, levels = CLASS_ORDER)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Disease_Class, y = ms_score_90pct, colour = Disease_Class)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, notch = F) +
  geom_beeswarm(alpha = 0.6, cex = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d() +
  theme_linedraw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio = 1) +
  labs(
    x     = NULL,
    y     = "MS score (95th pct, weighted)",
    title = "MS disease class: patient-level score (Blood)"
  ) -> p_disease_class
p_disease_class
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "fig3C_patient_disease_class.svg"), p_disease_class, width = 2.5, height = 2)
```

```{r model-comparison}
# Compare both models side by side for MS patients in Blood
patient_preds %>%
  filter(
    Disease == "Multiple sclerosis",
    BSource == "Blood"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = model, y = ms_score_90pct, colour = model)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, notch = T) +
  geom_beeswarm(alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d() +
  theme_linedraw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid      = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "MS score (95th pct, weighted)", title = "Model comparison — MS patients (Blood)") -> p_model_comp
p_model_comp
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "fig3A_patient_model_comparison.svg"), p_model_comp, width = 2.5, height = 2)
```
